blurb: Indian Springs Golf Club offers a meticulously maintained 9-hole golf course with hills, water, views, and large greens. Facilities include a renovated clubhouse, cafe, bar, patio, driving range, short-game practice area, and putting green. Instruction is available from a PGA Associate Pro, and the club hosts various leagues and youth programs.
